title: Taro and Pilaf Fritter with Zanzibari
description: A crispy and savory fritter made with taro and pilaf, flavored with the unique taste of zanzibari. Perfect for a gluten-free dinner.
instructions: Grate the taro and set aside.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked pilaf, grated taro, egg, and y.
Add the zanzibari and mix well.
Heat a non-stick pan with a small amount of oil over medium heat.
Using a spoon, drop small portions of the taro mixture into the pan.
Fry until golden brown and crispy, flipping halfway through.
Serve hot with your favorite chutney or raita.
Note: Be careful not to overcrowd the pan, fry in batches if necessary.
